_comment: Per-area lint rule scoping, read by .claude/skills/{check-prose,check-formulas}. A file inherits the union of every matching pattern's `disable` list; anything not listed here gets all rules. Pass --all-rules to ignore this file.
_exclude_why: CLAUDE.md 是给 agent 看的说明，里面会引用反例（如 $x$, $w$ 这类演示记号、被禁用的 \operatorname），不是书稿；todo.md 是草稿，明确不属于书

scopes.why: 笔记贴合各自论文的记法（\boldsymbol、粗体大写矩阵），与书稿的记号约定不同，且是作者手写、刻意保留的
